subject.title: image tool: 60s timeout for Anthropic vision when direct API returns in ~2s

question: Should bare image-tool model identifiers remain explicitly provider-qualified, or should OpenClaw define and document a deterministic registry-based inference rule for ambiguous bare IDs?
rationale: The timeout investigation is a bug-fix path, but provider inference changes a public routing contract and cannot safely be chosen from the report alone.

options.title: Keep explicit provider IDs
options.body: Preserve the current unambiguous provider/model contract and improve the error or documentation for bare image-tool model IDs.

options.title: Define registry inference
options.body: Adopt a deterministic provider-selection rule only with documented ambiguity handling and compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit provider IDs
recommendation.body: Preserve the current unambiguous provider/model contract and improve the error or documentation for bare image-tool model IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only identified recent contributor connected to adjacent provider-stream routing behavior.
